channel.desc: James Bye swaps Albert Square for a Leicestershire property snoop with Martel, who auditions for a role in EastEnders while James gets stuck into the stripping-out. In South Yorkshire, the size of a garden has Dion thinking about building plots. And we hit replay on a property Martin explored back in 2004, one of the oldest buildings in Derbyshire.
